vibe_rationale: Founder-led, community-first sauna festival with independent sauna makers and a wellness-culture core; a single scene with timed-session ticketing.
fit_notes: Adult, recovery-minded Pacific Northwest crowd (13 to 17s attend with a parent), with the clearest wellness fit in the batch; the community is still small. Thirty-six listed partners including wellness brands, a partnership page and a contact email. The 847 figure is tickets sold in 2025, not unique visitors. The 7 November edition is under three weeks away, so timing is tight.
